_meta.description: Curated well-known Ethereum mainnet addresses. Served as /labels.json; the frontend may use these to annotate address pages. Curated, not exhaustive.
_meta.how_to_extend: Append an object with address (checksummed 0x...), label, category, source (URL or 'Blockscout /addresses lookup'), verified (true only if confirmed against Blockscout or the project's own docs), and verified_via. Do not add an address from memory alone.
_meta.verification: Each entry was checked against Blockscout v2 /addresses/{hash} (token name / ENS / contract name) on 2026-11-05, or against the project's own published deployment docs where Blockscout lookups timed out. Entries that could not be confirmed were dropped or marked verified:false.
